css.against: @coinbase/cds-web@9.29.0 createThemeCssVars(defaultTheme), as ThemeProvider builds it for each Mode

notes.message: currentColor (--color-currentColor) is not carried: it is the CSS keyword, not a colour, in both schemes.

radio has no component token map: @coinbase/cds-common@9.29.0 has no esm/tokens/radio.js, so the document carries no radio component or Synthesized tokens, only the Theme, Layout and Type tokens its Contract binds.

foregroundMuted is @deprecated in packages/common/src/types/ButtonBaseProps.ts ("Use `secondary` directly."); its tokens, plain and transparent, have scopes [], which keep them out of Figma's pickers.

CDS emits no custom property for a Button token: Button paints var(--color-<token>), the Theme colour each one aliases, so codeSyntax is empty and a reference by that custom property matches the Theme colour.

Synthesized tokens (ADR 0009): Interactable computes each state's colour per element with getBlendedColor and sets it inline as --inter-hover-bg, --inter-hover-borderColor, --inter-press-bg, --inter-press-borderColor, --inter-disable-bg, --inter-disable-borderColor. Those properties hold a different colour on every element, so codeSyntax is empty. Disabled also sets opacity 0.5 on the whole element (accessibleOpacityDisabled), which no colour token carries.
The schema has no Icon size or Control size group for CDS; they take the Size scope WIDTH_HEIGHT, as Carbon's Icon size does.
Shadow (elevation1, elevation2) is not carried: the Foundations document holds variables and Text Styles, not effect styles.
avatarSize is not carried: Avatar is not a family this document serves.
Illustration colours are not carried: they paint CDS's themeable SVG illustrations, not components.
textTransform is not carried: a Text Style has no text case. CDS sets caption to uppercase; the caption Text Style is not.
fontFamilyMono is not carried: the Text Styles are CDS's sans styles (fontFamily).
The scheme-fixed copies --lightColor-* and --darkColor-* are not carried: the Theme's Light and Dark Modes hold the same values, under --color-*.

The unprefixed spectrum (--blue60) is the active scheme's copy of --light-blue60 or --dark-blue60; the Primitives carry both schemes by those names. Primitives have no codeSyntax: they are hidden, and CDS emits them as "r,g,b" triplets, not colours.
Only defaultTheme is carried. CDS Web's other themes (coinbaseDenseTheme, coinbaseHighContrastTheme, coinbaseTheme, defaultHighContrastTheme) are not.
Light and Dark have no selector: ThemeProvider sets the custom properties inline on its element for its activeColorScheme, and no class switches them. A preview shows a Mode by its key.
Text Styles are named by CDS's text keys and use Inter, the first family of --defaultFont-sans. CDS sets no letter spacing, so it is 0.
fontStyle is the Figma style each weight is named by (Regular, Semi Bold); not yet checked against the Inter styles Figma offers.
